nodes.title: Agreement of a circuit with a Boolean function

nodes.summary: For a list $C$ of encoded gates and a list $x$ of Booleans of length $\ell$, the gate values of $C$ on $x$ are obtained by decoding each pair of $C$ to a gate of a flat Boolean circuit on $\ell$ inputs and evaluating the decoded circuit with the assignment that gives input $i$ the value $x_i$; the result lists the values of all gates in order. nodes.title: Gate values of an encoded circuit

nodes.summary: For $n > 0$ and $k$ blocks $x_0, \dots, x_{k-1}$ of $n$ bits each, the flattened string has $nk$ bits, and its bit $i$ is bit $i \bmod n$ of the block $x_{\lfloor i/n \rfloor}$.
nodes.title: Flattening blocks of bits

nodes.summary: For $k$ bits $b_0, \dots, b_{k-1}$, their XOR is true if and only if an odd number of the $b_i$ are true.
nodes.title: XOR of finitely many bits

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ and a Boolean function $f$ on $n$ bits, the function $f^{\oplus k}$ takes $k$ blocks $x_0, \dots, x_{k-1}$ of $n$ bits each to $f(x_0) \oplus \cdots \oplus f(x_{k-1})$, which is true if and only if an odd number of the values $f(x_i)$ are true.
nodes.title: XOR of independent copies of a function

nodes.summary: An encoded gate is a pair $(k, r)$ of a natural number $k$ (the gate kind) and a list $r$ of natural numbers (its references), the shared (kind, references) encoding of gates of flat Boolean circuits.
nodes.title: Encoded gates

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
